label: Continental
summary: Open country with forests, hills and fens; the gold mine or shrine stands at the heart.

label: Highlands
summary: A ring of mountains shelters every home valley. Two guarded passes lead out.

label: Lake Isle
summary: A great lake fills the center. The contested site stands on an island reached by one causeway per empire.

label: Wild Forest
summary: Deep forest everywhere; travel is slow and roads are lifelines. Clearings hold the treasures.

label: Marshlands
summary: Fens and black pools split the land. The paths between them are worth fighting for.

label: Crossroads
summary: Peaks ring a rich center that can be entered only through one strongly guarded gate per empire.

label: Archipelago
summary: Every empire rules its own island. A sandbar leads to the central isle; twin portals cross the straits.

label: Twin Continents
summary: A strait splits the world in two. The only land bridge runs through the contested center; twin portals cross the water.

label: Central Valley
summary: A rich valley of mines lies below a ring of ridges, reached through two guarded passes per empire.

label: The Shattered Crown
summary: Separate island kingdoms surround the broken Crown. Sail for distant riches, capture landing beaches, and carry your army across the sea to conquer.

label: The Serpent Straits
summary: Rival harbors face a maze of island straits. Seize the inner passages or sail around the outer coast to land behind the enemy.
